_readme: On-site AR / 360 content per parcel. Keys under 'parcels' are TCAD property IDs (the panel header value). Each entry may have: title, model (USDZ path relative to ar/), pano (equirectangular image path relative to ar/), hoverlay (scene URL), notes. The 'default' entry is offered on EVERY parcel — handy while testing; delete it once real models exist. See ar/GUIDE.md for the full workflow.

default.title: Calibration cube (1 m test)
default.notes: Test model: an orange cube exactly 1 m per side. Place it on the ground and check the scale before trusting a building model.
